relations.name: source_invoice
relations.meaning: A billed invoice row as recorded in billing sources, including identifier, billed name, amount, currency, period, and payment status.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/billing/invoices.json by invoice_id.
relations.construction_rule: Parse invoices.json; emit one tuple per invoice object; invoice holds join key form billing:<invoice_id> or equivalent referent id, invoice_id holds the bare source id.

relations.name: source_crm_account
relations.meaning: A CRM account record with native account identifier and account name as recorded in CRM.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/crm.csv by crm_account_id row.
relations.construction_rule: Parse crm.csv; account holds join key form crm:<crm_account_id>.

relations.name: source_registry_entity
relations.meaning: A company registry row with company number and legal name as recorded in the registry source.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/company_registry.csv by company_number row.
relations.construction_rule: Parse company_registry.csv; entity holds join key form registry:<company_number>.

relations.name: source_contract
relations.meaning: A contract document header with source contract identifier and counterparty name string exactly as written in the contract file.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/contracts/<filename>.md header counterparty line.
relations.construction_rule: Enumerate sources/contracts/*.md; contract holds join key contract:<filename without .md>; contract_id holds bare filename stem; counterparty holds literal counterparty string from the document.

relations.name: source_contract_clause
relations.meaning: A verbatim contractual clause excerpt from a contract document section as recorded in the source.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/contracts/<filename>.md section text span.
relations.construction_rule: Split each contract markdown into numbered sections; emit one tuple per section with section label and full section text.

relations.name: source_contract_schedule
relations.meaning: Contract effective date, term description, and recorded expiry date as stated in the contract document header.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/contracts/<filename>.md header Effective/Term/Expiry lines.
relations.construction_rule: Parse contract header metadata lines; expiry_date empty when not stated.

relations.name: identity_judgment
relations.meaning: Two cross-source identifiers denote the same legal counterparty, are distinct, or remain unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet. SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence, not compatibility.
relations.construction_rule: For each identity_link_candidate pair, resolve disposition from source evidence and commercial_notes where applicable; never infer SAME_ENTITY from similarity alone.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Emit directed pairs linking crm:, billing:, contract:, and registry: identifiers required to connect each commercially relevant CRM account to its billed name, governing contract, and registry candidate rows per purpose B link pattern.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether two identifiers denote the same legal counterparty.

relations.name: acquisition_clause_judgment
relations.meaning: Whether an active-contract candidate bears a specific acquisition-relevant clause kind grounded in explicit contractual language.
relations.grounding_contract: Each ACCEPT grounded to verbatim clause text in source_contract_clause; REJECT requires reviewed clause set for the contract.
relations.construction_rule: Classify source_contract_clause text against purpose A acquisition-relevant kinds; do not infer from commercial notes or name similarity alone.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: For each source_contract and each allowed acquisition clause kind in purpose A, emit a candidate tuple for review.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the contract contains the stated acquisition-relevant clause kind.

relations.name: contract_liveness_judgment
relations.meaning: Whether a contract document counts as an active governing agreement under purpose liveness rules, notably treating an expired statement of work as inactive.
relations.grounding_contract: Judgment grounded to source_contract_schedule dates and document type; active=false for recorded expired SOW.
relations.construction_rule: Apply purpose active-contract threshold to source_contract_schedule and document kind; expired SOW with past expiry_date is inactive.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Emit one candidate per source_contract tuple.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the contract is currently active for purpose inclusion.

relations.name: invoice_contract_association
relations.meaning: Whether a billed invoice can be confidently associated with a governing contract and its counterparty for purpose A reporting.
relations.grounding_contract: Asserted association requires confident identity linkage between invoice billed name and contract counterparty plus commercial relationship evidence.
relations.construction_rule: Derive from identity_judgment links among billing:, contract:, and crm: identifiers plus commercial_notes; map SAME_ENTITY chains to asserted, else unresolved.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: For each source_invoice and each source_contract whose counterparty is a candidate match for the billed name, emit a candidate association pair.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the invoice billed name corresponds to the contract counterparty and the stated contract governs the relationship.

relations.name: obligation_kind_judgment
relations.meaning: Whether an active contract contains a purpose C obligation kind: exclusivity, auto_renewal, or rolling_term.
relations.grounding_contract: Each ACCEPT grounded to verbatim clause or term language in source_contract_clause or source_contract_schedule.
relations.construction_rule: Classify contract text into exclusivity, auto_renewal, or rolling_term per purpose C taxonomy; only on contracts judged active.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: For each contract_liveness_judgment with ACTIVE and each obligation kind in purpose C vocabulary, emit a candidate tuple.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the contract contains the stated commercial obligation kind.

relations.name: commercial_dependency_judgment
relations.meaning: Whether a counterparty-contract pair is commercially dependent under purpose C two-prong test or remains unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Dependent status requires both prongs satisfied with resolved identity joins; unresolved when any required join or prong evidence is missing.
relations.construction_rule: Conjoin current-relationship prong (open invoice or active auto-renew/rolling contract) with obligation_kind_judgment ACCEPT; propagate UNRESOLVED identity links from purpose B as unresolved status.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: For each active contract with at least one ACCEPT obligation_kind_judgment or open invoice on a linked counterparty identifier, emit a candidate dependency row.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the counterparty is commercially dependent on the contract under purpose C criteria.

relations.name: identity_link_candidates
relations.meaning: Directed pairs of cross-source identifiers that purpose B requires an explicit identity judgment on.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation inputs grounded to source_crm_account, source_invoice, source_contract, and source_registry_entity rows in commercial scope.
relations.construction_rule: SQL derivation enumerating required crm-billing-contract-registry link pairs per purpose B required_link_pattern without assigning disposition.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Join CRM accounts to invoices, contracts, and registry rows sharing commercial relationship cues; emit all required directed pairs.

relations.name: open_invoices_by_contract
relations.meaning: Open invoices linked to a contract through resolved identity and association judgments for purpose C aggregation.
relations.grounding_contract: Each row derived from source_invoice status=open joined via identity_judgment and invoice_contract_association where dispositions permit linkage.
relations.construction_rule: SQL derivation over source_invoice, identity_judgment, and invoice_contract_association; exclude rows blocked by UNRESOLVED identity on the join path.

limitations: contract_liveness_judgment dispositions ACTIVE/INACTIVE/UNRESOLVED are mapped to consumer boolean active in purpose computations.
commercial_dependency_judgment has no closed-world negative disposition; not-dependent rows are omitted rather than asserted.
invoice_contract_association and commercial_dependency_judgment lack negative dispositions per purpose epistemic contracts; absence of asserted is not DISTINCT.
